Live shopping in the United States reaches a young and mobile audience. Most buyers arrive from a phone rather than a desktop and the fact that a stream can be watched on a telephone during a commute is what keeps sessions short and frequent. Deal hunters and brand followers dominate and both expect an answer in the chat within seconds.

P.P.S. Ask each platform for its own demographic report before trusting any of this.

answer:
Dial outlook.office365.com:993 with the standard library and wrap the connection in an imapclient. Build the XOAUTH2 payload by hand and send it as a raw AUTHENTICATE command so go-sasl never enters the build.

One point to rub in: Office 365 refuses the token unless IMAP is enabled for the mailbox. A silent NO is a cow of a permissions problem rather than a bug in your code.

<<Shipping .NET Core logs to Logstash>>

Write structured events to a TCP socket and let Logstash read them on a json_lines input.

* Add Serilog.Sinks.Network and point it at tcp://logstash-host:5000 with a JsonFormatter.
